metadata.scenario: A prospect inquires about the pricing for home security system installations. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I hope you're doing well! Hi Helen! I'm doing great, thank you. How about you? I'm good, thanks! I'm calling because I wanted to inquire about your home security system installations. Oh, I think there might be some confusion. We don’t provide home security systems; we focus on home healthcare services. Oh, I'm sorry about that! I must have mixed up the numbers. Can you tell me more about what your services include? Absolutely! We offer a range of services like skilled nursing care, physical therapy, and personal care assistance. That sounds great! I'm currently on physical therapy after my shoulder surgery, and I’ve been with you guys for about nine months now. Yes, I remember! You've been doing really well. Are you looking for additional services or to continue your current plan? Well, I just wanted to check if there's anything new that might help my recovery. We can certainly look into adding more sessions if needed, or even some companion care to help with daily activities. Companion care sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about that? Sure! Companion care includes social interaction, light housekeeping, and even meal preparation. It's priced at $25 to $30 per hour. That could be helpful. How many hours would you recommend per week? It really depends on your needs, but many clients find 2 to 4 hours a week beneficial. Okay, that makes sense. Would I be able to meet the caregiver first? Yes, we always arrange a meeting for a good fit. Would you like me to check availability? Yes, please! That would be great. I can set that up for you. Would you prefer mornings or afternoons? Mornings work best for me. Perfect! I’ll coordinate that and get back to you. Anything else you need today? No, I think that covers it! Thank you for your help, Margaret. You're very welcome, Helen! I’ll follow up with you soon regarding the caregiver meeting. Sounds good, I appreciate it! Thank you for calling! Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
